mapper.insert: INSERT INTO codef_connections (user_id, connected_id, connection_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{connectedId}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, connected_id, connection_status, last_synced_at FROM codef_connections WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO codef_connected_institutions (codef_connection_id, organization_code, organization_name, business_type, connection_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{codefConnectionId}, #{organizationCode}, #{organizationName}, #{businessType}, 'CONNECTED', NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO accounts (user_id, codef_connection_id, account_name, account_number, account_type, balance, withdrawable_amount, recognized_amount, connection_type, last_synced_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{codefConnectionId}, #{accountName}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountType}, #{balance}, #{withdrawableAmount}, 0, 'CODEF', NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET balance = #{balance}, withdrawable_amount = #{withdrawableAmount}, codef_connection_id = #{codefConnectionId}, is_active = TRUE, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_number = #{accountNumber} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_name, account_number, account_type, balance, withdrawable_amount, recognized_amount, is_travel_fund_included, last_synced_at FROM accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_active = TRUE
SELECT id, organization_code, institution_name, business_type, logo_url, display_order FROM supported_institutions WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO transactions (account_id, external_key, transaction_date, transaction_time, transaction_type, transaction_region, amount, balance_after, merchant_name) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{externalKey}, #{transactionDate}, #{transactionTime}, #{transactionType}, #{transactionRegion}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{merchantName})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, card_id, external_key, transaction_date, transaction_time, transaction_type, transaction_region, amount, balance_after, merchant_name, memo, category_id FROM transactions WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY transaction_date DESC, transaction_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.account_number, a.account_type, a.balance, i.organization_code FROM accounts a JOIN codef_connected_institutions i ON a.codef_connection_id = i.codef_connection_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.account_id, t.card_id, t.external_key, t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.transaction_type, t.transaction_region, t.amount, t.balance_after, t.merchant_name, t.memo, t.category_id FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE t.id = #{transactionId} AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id SET t.category_id = #{categoryId}, t.memo = #{memo}, t.updated_at = NOW() WHERE t.id = #{transactionId} AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_deleted = 0
